news.title: Price target decreased by 7.4% to ₹369
news.body: Down from ₹399, the current price target is an average from 2 analysts. New target price is 19% above last closing price of ₹310. Stock is down 45% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹10.10 for next year compared to ₹9.07 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.07 (up from ₹7.21 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹25.7b (up 27% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.64b (up 23% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 10% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.3%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 3.1%. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 75% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 108% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Limited Announces CEO Changes
news.body: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Limited informed that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on January 8, 2026, took a note of resignation of Mr. Mukul Srivastava as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) with effect from close of business hours of January 7, 2026. Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Board of Directors, Mr. Satyen J. Mamtora, Managing Director of the Company was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Company with effective from January 8, 2026. Mr. Satyen J. Mamtora shall hold the designation of Managing Director & CEO of the Company with effect from aforesaid date.  Mr. Satyen J. Mamtora is the Managing Director of Transformers & Rectifiers (India) Limited (TARIL) and second-generation entrepreneur
